title: Neo4j
scope: A complete Neo4j path covering graph modeling, Cypher, constraints and indexes, query planning, transactions, import, APOC, drivers, clustering, backup, security, observability, composite databases, change data capture, full-text and vector search, GraphRAG, Graph Data Science, algorithms, machine learning, performance engineering, and production architecture.
coverage_note: Current Neo4j DBMS/Cypher concepts, 2026-era vector SEARCH capabilities, Graph Data Science, clustering, CDC, and modern application integration
